From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: GreenByte demo — quick scheduling & handoff note

Hi Claire,

Thanks again for taking a look at Redwood. I wanted to propose a live demo and double-check timezones so we can do a smooth handoff: I (Jordan, US SDR) will run the intro and product overview, then loop in Lauren (EU AE) for the feature deep-dive and commercial framing. Suresh, if you want to join from PayMol side, feel free — we can make the session short and focused.

Proposed slots (I listed local times to avoid timezone confusion):
- Wed Apr 7 — 07:00 PDT / 10:00 EDT / 16:00 CET (Paris) — 20:30 IST
- Wed Apr 7 — 09:00 PDT / 12:00 EDT / 18:00 CET (Paris) — 22:30 IST

If neither works, tell me the windows that suit Claire and Suresh and we’ll adapt. Note: some EU calendars I’ve seen switch with local DST this week, so I included CET explicitly. I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock a slot.

Agenda (draft):
- 10 min intro + goals (Jordan)
- 25 min product demo & live Qs (Lauren)
- 10 min integration and next steps (all)

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (draft).

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake

Hi Jordan,

Thanks — appreciate the breakdown. Both Suresh and I prefer late afternoon CET if possible (gives our CTO time to join after internal standups). The 16:00 CET option on Wed Apr 7 looks ideal for us. Quick note: France switched to DST last weekend so our calendar shows CEST — the 16:00 CET you listed maps to 17:00 CEST; can you confirm which you mean so we don’t miss Lauren?

If it helps, our preferred window is 17:00–18:00 CEST (that’s 08:00–09:00 PDT).

Best,
Claire

claire@greenbyte.fr

Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenByte demo — quick scheduling & handoff note

Great question — thanks for flagging the DST / CET vs CEST mismatch.

Claire — when I wrote CET I meant the local Paris time, which should indeed be CEST (UTC+2) now. So the 16:00 CET line should be treated as 17:00 CEST. To avoid ambiguity, let’s lock on: Wed Apr 7 at 17:00 CEST / 08:00 PDT. Lauren — can you join at 17:00 CEST? If not, please suggest an alternate within 17:00–18:00 CEST.

Mateo — can you add a short internal note in HubSpot about the handoff and copy the preferred meeting window? I’ll follow up with the calendar invite and the agenda.

Thanks, Jordan

On a process note for the team: for cross-region demos I’ll always include the exact UTC offset (e.g., CEST/UTC+2) in the invite so that PayMol and GreenByte calendars normalize correctly.
